title: Build the Unbilled Work Review Queue Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/unbilled-work-review-queue.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/kit.
Kit contents: Unbilled Work Setup Checklist; Unbilled Queue Prompt; Week-to-Week Billing Log Prompt; Skip Rules and Minimum Worksheet; Billing Log Template; Invoice Outline Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Job Export; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'Unbilled Work Review Queue', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a table with exactly 4 data rows whose job ids are J-88, J-91, J-70, and J-94, and whose customers include Northgate Clinic, Pell & Co, Harbor Lane, and Birchwood. It also shows the as-of date 2026-05-11 and the minimum $150.

Step 2 shows the exact heading 'SKIP RULES FIRST'. J-91 is SKIPPED with text containing 'invoice_id' and 'INV-220'. J-70 is SKIPPED with text containing 'warranty'. J-94 is SKIPPED with text containing '$85' and '$150'.

Step 3 lists exactly 1 queued row, J-88. It shows CONFIRMED text containing 'Northgate Clinic', 'J-88', '2026-04-22', '12', '85', and '1020'. It shows the outline text 'Northgate Clinic, J-88, 12 hours at $85, $1,020, date 2026-04-22' and the exact sentence 'Do not add tax or terms not in the export.' It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'NEEDS YOUR CHECK', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. AI INTERPRETATION contains 'blank invoice id' and 'does not prove'.
Step 4 shows the J-88 outline. Activating 'Check numbers against the export row' reveals three rows (hours, rate, amount), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values 12, 85, and 1020.

Step 5 shows the fictional billing log with J-88 invoiced and INV-241, and a mock next-week run as of 2026-05-18. The run lists J-88 as skipped with text containing 'INV-241' and 'invoiced', and shows 'Logged invoiced work is not listed again.'

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You create the invoice. Nothing is sent or collected.' and 'Do not add tax or terms not in the export.' and a link to /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every job id, customer, amount, hour, rate, invoice id, and date in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.
Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', or 'per month'. The only dollar figures are the fictional job amounts and the fictional $150 minimum.
Neither page contains a percentage, a collection-rate figure, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue'.
GET /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/kit.

Unbilled Work Review Queue is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'unbilled-work-review-queue', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'unbilled-work-review-queue') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'Unbilled Work Review Queue Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no Unbilled Work Review Queue entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Unbilled Queue Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'SKIP RULES FIRST', 'CONFIRMED', 'NEEDS YOUR CHECK', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'invoice_id', 'warranty', 'oldest', 'Do not invent', 'Do not add tax', 'Do not send', 'Nothing is sent or collected'.
The Week-to-Week Billing Log Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'billing log', 'invoiced', 'write-off', 'hold', 'invoice_id', 'Do not send', 'Nothing is sent or collected'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Skip Rules and Minimum Worksheet has a visible label 'Minimum amount to bill (USD)' whose default value is '150', a visible label 'Statuses that are never billed (one per line)' whose default value is 'warranty', a visible label 'Jobs or customers to always skip (one per line)', plus a 'Generate My Unbilled Skip Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Skip when invoice_id is present.', 'Never bill statuses: warranty.', 'Skip amounts below $150.', 'Skip dates after the as-of date.', 'Skip disputed jobs.', 'Rank remaining rows by oldest completion date first.', 'Invoice outline uses only customer, id, date, hours, rate, and amount from the export.', 'Do not invent tax, terms, or line items.', 'A blank invoice id is not proof the customer was never billed off-export.', and 'You create the invoice. Nothing is sent or collected.' The block has a Copy button. The block contains no 'Always skip' line.
If the minimum-amount field is empty, whitespace only, or negative, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a minimum amount of 0 or more.' and generates no rules block.

When 'Jobs or customers to always skip (one per line)' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Always skip' line. When it contains 'Northgate Clinic', the block contains 'Always skip: Northgate Clinic'.
When 'Statuses that are never billed (one per line)' contains 'warranty' and 'write-off' on two lines, the generated rules block contains 'Never bill statuses: warranty; write-off.'.

The Billing Log Template shows the columns week_of, job, customer, action_taken, outcome, invoice_id, notes. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'week_of,job,customer,action_taken,outcome,invoice_id,notes' and whose J-88 row contains '2026-05-11', 'Northgate Clinic', 'invoiced', and 'INV-241'.

The Invoice Outline Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.

The Fictional Sample Job Export section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the job,customer,completed,hours,rate,amount,invoice_id,status rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the Unbilled Work Review Queue card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no Unbilled Work Review Queue entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the Unbilled Work Review Queue card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack, Google Ads Performance Coach, Quote Request Assistant, AI Expense Watchdog, and No-show Recovery Assistant entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/, components/premium/unbilled-work-review-queue/, and src/lib/premium/unbilled-work-review-queue/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/unbilled-work-review-queue/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/unbilled-work-review-queue/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
